lines.text: God tells the land of Israel that the end has come upon the four corners of the land.
God says there is panic on the mountains, and violence has grown into a rod to punish wickedness.
God says the sword is outside, and the survivors will live in the desert, moaning like doves of the valley.
God says the people's silver and gold cannot save them, and He will hand their idols over as plunder to priests.
God says He will bring the most wicked of nations, and the people will seek a vision from a prophet.
